documents.description: scan_directory() incremental os.walk indexer with SKIP_DIRS/SKIP_FILES; get_file_tree() for the Explorer.

documents.title: Categorizer
documents.description: get_category() extension->category; get_archive_era() FORWARD/BACKWARD; batched categorize_files().

documents.title: Hasher
documents.description: xxhash64 partial + full; hash_candidates() three-phase size->partial->full pipeline; get_hash_progress().

documents.title: Duplicate detection
documents.description: find_duplicates() builds duplicate_groups/members; review/action workflow; execute_dedup_actions() (dry-run-safe delete/move/rename).

documents.title: Structure manager
documents.description: Canonical ARCHIVE folder tree (UNIT_RELATIVE_PATHS) create/validate/preview; Python port of ARCHIVE-ControlPanel.ps1.

documents.title: Move planner
documents.description: compute_target() / build_plan() — resolves ARCHIVE destinations by category + era; dry-run safe, reads DB only.

documents.title: Plan executor
documents.description: execute_plan() carries out moves with a batch_id, logs to operations with undo_path; get_organize_history()/get_undo_batches().

documents.title: Undo
documents.description: undo_batch() reverses a batch of logged operations.

documents.title: Maintenance
documents.description: VACUUM/ANALYZE, purge missing/resolved/old records, health_report() with recommendations; safe-only criteria.

documents.title: Config
documents.description: DEFAULT_CONFIG + config/config.yaml deep-merge; primary_drive overridden from naya.db personal.default_scan_drive.

documents.description: app (name/version/host/port 8000), archive (primary_drive, forward_year 2020), scanner skip rules, 8 category extension maps, scheduler intervals (scan 24h / dedup 168h).

documents.title: FileHQ database
documents.description: The catalogue: ~2,858,834 files, 694 duplicate_groups, 1,618 duplicate_members, 26 scans, 1 exception, schema_version 1 (created 2026-06-23). WAL mode, foreign keys on.

documents.title: Web templates
documents.description: dashboard, duplicates, explorer, organizer, tasks, history, reports, reports_print, exceptions, settings, structure, base.
